definitions: The centre of interest or activity.
The state or quality of having or producing clear visual definition.
A point at which rays of light or other radiation meet after reflection or refraction or through which they appear to diverge.
A point of convergence of an earthquake.
A point on an axis of an ellipse or hyperbola.
examples: The focus of the discussion was on the economy.
The camera struggled to find focus.
The lens has a variable focus.
The two foci of the ellipse.
